term.label: sequence_variation_increasing_level_of_transcript

definition.text: A sequence_variation that causes an increase in the level of mature, spliced and processed RNA, resulting from a change in the corresponding DNA sequence.

comments: OBSOLETE: This term was deleted as it conflated more than one term. The alteration is separate from the effect.
